note: Groupon deals for comedy clubs the Shack lists. Filled on Sundays by the morning refresh (scripts/refresh-extra.md). venues: {<venue name exactly as in events.json>: {t: what you get, p: Groupon price in $, v: listed value in $, u: the deal page, until: last valid day or null, chk: day last confirmed, fine: short fine print}}. The app shows a deal on that venue's comedy shows until it's 14 days past chk or past until.
